# Quantum Readout Rank Threshold

This repository studies how many identical copies a fixed measurement must process jointly to retain a uniform fraction of local SLD quantum Fisher information.

## Study route

- Selected educational anchor and notation/source bridge: learning/ANCHOR.md
- Complete common understanding map, M01–M30, with dependencies and source pointers: learning/MILESTONES.md
- Reader entrypoint and focused routes: learning/README.md

The single educational anchor is Demkowicz-Dobrzanski, Gorecki and Guta, Multi-parameter estimation beyond Quantum Fisher Information, J. Phys. A 53, 363001 (2020), arXiv:2001.11742v2, shared with Calibrated-Quantum-Readout. It supplies score, SLD, nuisance and collective-estimation foundations; the project supplies the fixed-rank design, Schur and exact Haar arguments. The 30-milestone map has 10 background and 20 narrative milestones and records conceptual targets rather than a reader's assessment history.

## Read by question

- Exact experiment, allowed apparatus and rank classification: science/model.md
- Two-copy SWAP and projective 3-design construction, every tangent component and circuit resources: science/two-copy-readout.md
- Exact continuous-Haar pair information for all seven rank-two qutrit tangent directions, strict near-boundary comparison with the adaptive one-copy ceiling, and its implementation limits: science/haar-pair-readout.md
- Arbitrary-outcome finite-block converse, Schur multiplicities and uniform normalized-effect argument: science/finite-block-obstruction.md
- Exact leading spectral-information coefficient, attaining binary measurement and limit order: science/singular-information.md
- Calibration, coherent block size, persistent memory and local versus global loss: science/interpretation.md
- Primary antecedents and matched comparisons: references/RELATED_WORK.md
- Bibliographic metadata: references/references.bib
- Executed finite checks, dependencies and boundaries: verification/README.md

Use the source definitions: J is single-copy SLD information, J_2=2J, and all input copies and measurement outcomes are charged. The exact rank-three minimax coefficient concerns one spectral tangent after taking the rare eigenvalue to zero with block size and the second eigenvalue fixed. Distinguish this from general finite-sample estimation or adaptive calibration.

For a connected account, start at README.md and science/README.md, then follow the model, finite-design construction, exact Haar comparison, converse, singular-coefficient calculation and interpretation. For reproduction, run the commands in verification/README.md. Finite numerical checks support the displayed identities; the general statements rely on the written proofs.

The sister Calibrated-Quantum-Readout repository owns the calibrated single-copy optimum and science/paid-calibration.md, which analyzes complete pilot transcripts and separate strong/weak eigenvector errors. This repository owns the exact Haar pair comparison. Its full-model fraction is greater than one quarter sufficiently near the rank-one boundary, tending to one quarter; no sharp finite-Clifford constant, universal paid-calibration crossover or finite-sample risk ordering is asserted. Scientific counterpart: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Calibrated-Quantum-Readout/blob/92a59ee026610f9a0e3c347630bd399421172337/science/paid-calibration.md .
